model.name: Watercolor Sketch Style [XL+Pony]
model.description:
A watercolor style that looks like sketched illustrations with loose paint. This is a strong style that applies well to most simple subjects, so just using the normal trigger is usually enough. If it isn't coming through enough or you want to tweak it you can try adding:

  • "watercolor sketch" (more simplistic, less detailed backgrounds)

  • "illustration" (less sketchy and more detailed backgrounds)

  • "watercolor painting" (less emphasis on the outlines)

model.name: Double Exposure Concept
model.description:
A concept for creating the double exposure effect on the body itself.

A strength between 0.6-0.8 works great

Instance token is: w0rld

Most training images consisted of the pose "from behind". So it is recommended to use this tag as well.

model.name: Aether Watercolor & Ink - LoRA for SDXL
model.description:
This is Aether Watercolor & Ink - a watercolor, ink, and sketch texture-based subject and object-oriented LoRA. It operates well without negative prompting for straightforward tasks. Be sure to explore the prompt examples alongside the images in this gallery.

Activate by using watercolor, ink and sketch as triggers, combined or seperate.

Special thanks to RunDiffusion for sponsoring the finetuning of this LoRA. It was developed using Lastben's SDXL LoRA trainer via RunDiffusion. Aether Watercolor & Ink is soon accessible on their platform for experimentation.
